questions.stem_text: What was the prevailing notion prior to the time of Lyell and Darwin?

options.A: Earth is millions of years old, and populations are unchanging.

options.C: Earth is a few thousand years old, and populations rapidly change.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Earth is a few thousand years old, and populations are unchanging.
